title: Three commercial ships struck by drones near Romania's Black Sea coast over two days
summary: Speaking at the military port of Constanța on Nov. 14, Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed that Romanian authorities had been notified of the incident and that an investigation was underway.

title: Drone attack kills 1, injures 4 in Russia's Rostov Oblast, governor says
summary: The attack damaged two electrical substations in Taganrog, including one supplying power to railway infrastructure. A fire broke out at a substation in the city's Shubin district, while power lines between the Taganrog-Passenger and Mikhailovka railway stations were left without electricity.

title: YouTube blocks 16 Russian channels in Ukraine, including 'Masha and the Bear' versions
summary: The latest restrictions are part of a broader effort to limit Russian influence on digital platforms. In October, Ukraine's National Security and Defense Council reported that another 39 channels spreading Russian propaganda had been blocked in Ukraine or removed from YouTube.

title: Fire reported at industrial facility in Russia's Tatarstan amid drone attack
